info.name: LifeFile SCOS - Whole Project API
info.description: Full Postman collection for the LifeFile SCOS Spring Boot backend. Set role credentials and run 00 - Start Here: Login before protected endpoints. Replace collection variables with real IDs from your database. Seed/reset requests are state-changing.
